units.source_text: 那段时间，丈夫总是往返于野犬屠宰场。

en.t: During that time, my husband was always going back and forth to the stray dog slaughterhouse.

units.source_text: 他需要用狗做胚胎学的实验材料。

en.t: He needed dogs as experimental material for embryology.

units.source_text: 从二百多条狗的腹部切取受精卵的某个部分。

en.t: He cut out a certain part of the fertilized eggs from the abdomens of more than two hundred dogs.

units.source_text: 如斯可爱的小猎狗，大概连屠夫都不忍心屠宰，于是丈夫就把它要了回来吧。

en.t: Such an adorable little hunting dog was probably more than even the butcher could bear to slaughter, so my husband must have asked to take it home.
